```{r}
datap=read.csv2("C:/Users/anaid/Documents/M2/projet_tutore/allergenchipchallenge-data-corrected-final-hdh-sfa.csv")
```

```{r}
dim(datap)
str(datap[, 1:13])
summary(datap$Age)
table(datap$Gender, useNA = "ifany")
table(datap$French_Region, useNA = "ifany")
table(datap$Rural_or_urban_area, useNA = "ifany")
```

librairies :

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(forcats)
```

```{r}
table(datap$Gender, useNA = "ifany")
table(datap$Rural_or_urban_area, useNA = "ifany")
table(datap$French_Region, useNA = "ifany")
```

### observation des données :



```{r}
boxplot(datap$Age, main = "Age (population totale)", ylab = "Age", col = "lightblue")

datap$Gender <- factor(datap$Gender, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Sexe 0", "Sexe 1"))  ### à executer 1 fois seuleent!!!!!
datap$French_Region <- factor(datap$French_Region)
datap$French_Residence_Department <- factor(datap$French_Residence_Department)

datap$Rural <- factor(datap$Rural_or_urban_area,
                      levels = c(0, 1, 9),
                      labels = c("Zone 0", "Zone 1", "Non renseigné"))


```

question: sexe 0= femme? ou homme ? car pas renseigné dans la doc

```{r}



#Distribution de l'âge
p1 =ggplot(datap, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30,
                 fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(datap$Age, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Distribution de l'âge", x = "Âge", y = "Densité") +
  theme_minimal()

#Répartition par sexe
p2 =datap %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gender)) %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gender, y = n, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(title = "Répartition par sexe", x = NULL, y = "Effectif") +
  theme_minimal()

#Répartition rural / urbain
p3 =datap %>%
  count(Rural) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Rural, y = n, fill = Rural)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")), vjust = -0.3) +
  labs(title = "Zone rurale / urbaine", x = NULL, y = "Effectif") +
  theme_minimal()

#répartition par région
p4 = datap %>%
  count(French_Region) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(French_Region, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Répartition par région", x = NULL, y = "Effectif") +
  theme_minimal()

#top 15 départements
p5 = datap %>%
  count(French_Residence_Department, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(French_Residence_Department, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "15 départements les plus représentés", x = NULL, y = "Effectif") +
  theme_minimal()

#Age selon le sexe
p6 =datap %>% filter(!is.na(Gender)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gender, y = Age, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Age selon le sexe", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")

#Age selon la zone rurale/urbaine (hors non renseignés)
p7= datap %>% filter(Rural != "Non renseigné") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Rural, y = Age, fill = Rural)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Age selon la zone (hors non renseignés)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")

#Age selon la région
p8 = ggplot(datap, aes(x = French_Region, y = Age, fill = French_Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Age selon la région", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Age selon la région et le sexe
p9 = datap %>% filter(!is.na(Gender)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = French_Region, y = Age, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Age selon la région et le sexe", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


plots <- list(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8, p9)
for (p in plots) print(p)



```
